preconditions.description: The input string s has a length between 5 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number k is equal to the number of distinct suffixes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(suffix) in {2, 3} for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: Each suffix has a length of either 2 or 3.

postconditions.expression: all(suffixes[i] != suffixes[i+1] for i in range(len(suffixes)-1))
postconditions.description: Suffixes are listed in lexicographical order without duplicates.

postconditions.expression: all(suffix not in stdin[i:i+len(suffix)] for i in range(5, len(stdin)-len(suffix)+1) for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: No suffix is repeated consecutively in the word.
